packet_admission.scope: packet shape and refreshed current-authority binding only

source_findings.finding: stern.handoff() creates the durable entityos_arbeitspaket and deterministic DB-derived handoff capsule but explicitly does not perform delegation/spawn itself.

The pinned plugin hooks.json registers SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, SessionEnd and PreCompact only; it does not register dedicated SubagentStart/SubagentStop/Task lifecycle events.

The inspected stern.py source contains no agent_id or tool_use_id binding. Generic subagent tool events may exist at runtime, but the current donor dispatcher does not durably preserve those identifiers in the inspected source.

Current official Claude Code documentation describes native agent_id in subagent lifecycle/tool-hook inputs, resumable subagents, nested child spawning and optional worktree isolation. These are candidate primitives only until the installed host build and hook payloads are observed.

architecture_conclusion.r2_interpretation: Existing Frankenstein delegated-work state is a candidate indigenous R2 substrate. The missing bridge is exact binding of workpackage_id to native agent_id/task_id/tool_use_id/generation/effect lineage, not a reason by itself to build a second child-agent runtime.
architecture_conclusion.grid10_action: Prefer instrumenting and governing the installed native child ABI first. Build bespoke RAH/headless spawn plumbing only for capabilities demonstrated missing by the installed runtime.
architecture_conclusion.efficiency_policy: Preserve owner-original DIRECT_SMALL versus DELEGATE_BUILD classification; do not spawn children for trivial already-known changes merely to satisfy a slogan.

counterhypotheses: Host/global settings may already register child lifecycle hooks outside the versioned donor plugin.
The installed Claude Code build may differ materially from current documentation or have Agent/subagent facilities disabled.
Native agent_id may not be sufficient for safe parallelism if worktree/path/edit/effect ownership remains shared or mutable.
required_trigger4_discriminators: Read-only pin of installed Claude Code version/build and relevant host delegation/settings hashes/spans.
One harmless real handoff -> native child -> SubagentStart/tool/SubagentStop capture -> reconcile, binding package_id to observed agent_id/task/tool identities.
Two-child disjoint scratch run with ordering/identity checks and optional worktree isolation variant.
DIRECT_SMALL control versus matched delegated build to measure coordinator-context growth, latency/tool overhead and verification quality.
next_exact_gate: Obtain bounded read-only installed-host evidence for Claude Code version/build and delegation settings, then run one non-destructive native child lifecycle probe if standing authority and available execution routing permit; until then classify native agent_id/task/worktree features as EXTERNAL_PRIMARY capability, not current-host fact.
